run_checkpoint_evaluation: run a JAX checkpoint evaluation on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, or MNIST test datasets
run_adversarial_attack: run a PGD-40 adversarial attack with Adam optimizer and margin loss on test images
build_wideresnet_model: build a WideResNet model with configurable depth and width using Haiku and swish activation
load_test_dataset: load and normalize MNIST, CIFAR-10, or CIFAR-100 test data into a batched TensorFlow dataset
evaluate_robust_accuracy: evaluate both clean accuracy and robust accuracy of a model against adversarial examples
